title: Create prefetch router — FastAPI endpoints for prefetch + outcome
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/memory/{project}/prefetch accepts {task: str, token_budget: int, role: str?} body
Pydantic models: PrefetchRequest (task max 500, token_budget 500-50000), PrefetchOutcomeRequest (outcome enum)
Prefetch flow: load memory → tune weights → score decisions → assemble bundle → return
Outcome flow: validate bundle_id → record outcome → return stats
Returns {bundle: [...], near_misses: [...], bundle_id: str, token_count: int}
Translates all domain errors to HTTP (404, 422, 500)
